throughput_boundary: The benchmark materializes list(loader) before timing, so image decode, resize, normalization, and batch loading are outside the timed interval. Each timed batch includes model forward, soft-target loss, backward, optimizer.step, and MPS synchronization when applicable; it is not an end-to-end epoch or formal-finetuning throughput.
throughput_test_setting: 128/224 pixels, batch size 16, 3 warm-up and 12 timed batches, ResNet-18 ImageNet initialization, train mode, SGD lr=1e-3, targets loaded
formal_training_difference: Formal runs used batch size 32, Adam lr=3e-4, weight decay=1e-4, layer4+head fine-tuning, three epochs, and their own data-loop timing; the feasibility throughput is not a direct formal-training timing.
peak_memory: not measured; values are decoded-tensor estimates only
